description: Explicit compile expectation for every tracked .calr fixture under samples/ and tests/, read by scripts/fixture_compile_check.py (Tier 1: samples/; Tier 2: samples/ and tests/). Every fixture is listed by path exactly once; there is no pattern or catch-all. compile = must compile. reject = must fail with exactly the listed error signature; negativeKind designed means the fixture exists to fail, incidental means nothing compiles it and it is invalid Calor that the compiler rejects correctly. known-failure = a real compiler failure, kept as a failure and never counted as a pass. Error signature = one 'file|code|declaration|message' entry per error-severity diagnostic (declaration is '-' or the exact scratch-sidecar descriptor [relative input file,kind,container,name,signature]; file is the base name; Calor1002 carries its Roslyn code; whitespace collapsed), sorted, duplicates kept. Options mirror the fixture's consumer and are limited to the checker's allowlist. The checker compiles each fixture once; it performs no AST round trip. This is a current-compiler lane, not historical replay. currentInputs names the explicit original-to-current-copy registry: original subject registrations and expectations are retained, and reports show the actual currentFiles. Every tracked current copy also has its own explicit registration.
